info.name: Search OSM Objects By Name Or Address

params.name: q
params.description: Free-form query string. Cannot be combined with structured query parameters.

params.name: amenity
params.description: Name or type of point of interest.

params.name: street
params.description: House number and street name.

params.name: format
params.description: Output format.

params.name: json_callback
params.description: Wrap JSON output in a JSONP callback.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of returned results.

params.name: addressdetails
params.description: Include a breakdown of the address into elements.

params.name: extratags
params.description: Include additional information (Wikipedia link, opening hours, etc.).

params.name: namedetails
params.description: Include a full list of names for the result.

params.name: accept-language
params.description:
Preferred language order for showing search results, in browser-style
format (e.g. `en-US,en;q=0.5`). Overrides the HTTP Accept-Language
header.

params.name: countrycodes
params.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to limit results to.

params.name: exclude_place_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of place IDs to exclude from the result set.

params.name: viewbox
params.description:
Bounding box `x1,y1,x2,y2` (longitudes and latitudes) used to bias
results toward a geographic area.

params.name: bounded
params.description: When set, restrict results strictly to the viewbox.

params.name: polygon_geojson
params.description: Output geometry as GeoJSON.

params.name: polygon_kml
params.description: Output geometry as KML.

params.name: polygon_svg
params.description: Output geometry as SVG.

params.name: polygon_text
params.description: Output geometry as WKT.

params.name: polygon_threshold
params.description: Simplification tolerance for polygon output, in degrees.

params.name: dedupe
params.description: Remove duplicate hits from the result set.

params.name: layer
params.description:
Restrict results to one or more feature layers. Comma-separated list of
`address`, `poi`, `railway`, `natural`, `manmade`.

params.name: featureType
params.description: Restrict search results to a single feature type.

params.name: email
params.description:
Email address identifying you when making high-volume requests. Required
by the OSMF usage policy at sustained traffic levels.

params.name: debug
params.description: Return verbose HTML output containing internal debugging information.

items.docs:
Forward-geocode a free-form or structured query and return matching
OSM objects. Use the free-form `q` parameter or one of the structured
parameters (`amenity`, `street`, `city`, `county`, `state`, `country`,
`postalcode`) — the two query styles cannot be combined.
